note.en: Legs follow the hill-country ridge road, the Jordan-valley pilgrim road, and Galilee lake shores. The traditional southern itinerary (Succoth, the Bitter Lakes crossing region, the west-Sinai coast to Jebel Musa), north to Kadesh, then the detour around Edom to the King's Highway and Mount Nebo. The route is disputed; this is the traditional reconstruction. Waypoints are drawn at map resolution along the documented route; the path is illustrative between attested points. Scripture records no path for a drifting ark — these legs are schematic connectors across the Mesopotamian basin between the traditional embarkation region, the mountains of Ararat, and the plain of Shinar, drawn for orientation only.
